title: TimeTrackingCategoryCompact
description: A *time tracking category* is a label that can be assigned to time tracking entries. Categories are workspace-scoped and allow users to classify logged time (e.g., 'Development', 'Meetings').

gid.description: Globally unique identifier of the resource, as a string.

resource_type.description: The base type of this resource.

name.description: The name of the time tracking category.

color.description: The color associated with this category for display purposes.
